title: Say Komunidad ya Inmabobon ed Agew na Painawa
intro: Onloob ed sakey a panaayaman ed gilig na dayat a ditan et walay ganggan na Dios ya angigana na sakey ya agew parad panagdayew tan panag-amper. Sakey a grupo ed sayan komunidad so nanpili ya suboken so limitasyon na satan a ganggan panamegley na sakey a masilib a plano, ya angitonton ed sakey a pananguman ya onagel ed loob na saray panaon. Siopa irayan kamarerwa, tan antoy agawa ed sikara?
clues: Say panaayaman mi et asingger ed gilig na dayat, a ditan et say dayat so panaayaman mi.
Ingganggan itayon mangigalang ed sakey ya agew ed sakey simba, ya ibiig itan ed saray minumundon gegemtan.
Diad saman ya agew, sinmabi ed sikami so dakel a sira, a singa ra mansusubok ed sikami a sumlangen so ganggan.
Nanggawa kami na plano pian naerel iray sira diad bisperas na sagradon agew, insan mi alaen iratan kayari na satan.
Nen wala ray arum ed sikami ya amasakbay sumpad sayan panagpalikdo, ag mi dinengel so simbawa ra tan nantultuloy kami.
Lapud impakasumlang mi, nagmaliw kamin singa ayep, minudmora tan impulisay.

arabic: وَلَقَدْ عَلِمْتُمُ ٱلَّذِينَ ٱعْتَدَوْا۟ مِنكُمْ فِى ٱلسَّبْتِ فَقُلْنَا لَهُمْ كُونُوا۟ قِرَدَةً خَـٰسِـِٔينَ
verse: And you had already known about those who transgressed among you concerning the sabbath, and We said to them, "Be apes, despised." (2:65)
